### 2026-10-09 – Entry #1: I did a ton of research into what the rules for the AIAA Build competition entails and what the PCB could possibly need. I decided on a very small budget STM32 since the task didn't seem to

**9.5h**

Entry #1: I did a ton of research into what the rules for the AIAA Build competition entails and what the PCB could possibly need. I decided on a very small budget STM32 since the task didn't seem to need more computing power, and since I've always wanted to work on a STM32.
I started routing the PCB and drafted the schematic. I'll pick out parts next time. I also went through and cleared up any errors with the electric rules checker.

Cleaned up draft schematic:
